amendment_scope: Only join/count-transformation gates were clarified after expression schema inspection and before outcomes; donor sets, endpoints, models, covariates, floors, and BH families were not changed

common.p1_summary: Mean per-cell log1p(CPM) within donor and released broad cell type; detected P1 up mean minus detected P1 down mean
common.p1_matched_null: 200 expression-decile-matched random-signature draws without replacement, excluding detected P1 genes, seed 20261105; centered two-sided empirical p=(1+extreme)/201
common.pseudobulk: Sum released corrected/raw UMI counts across all pieces and cells within donor-cell type, then log1p(CPM); filter to >=10 summed counts and detection in >=2 included donors without using age outcomes
common.clr: All released non-unknown coarse labels define the donor composition universe, including zero counts; 0.5-cell pseudocount
common.effect_reporting: Effect, standard error, 95% CI, nominal p and BH q; non-significance is not equivalence

input: Eight public per-donor Cell Ranger filtered feature-barcode H5 files and released snRNA metadata celltype2 broad annotations; no ATAC expression/peak download
count_and_join_gate: Stream every stored matrix value and require finite nonnegative integers; unique feature IDs and per-donor barcodes; exact one-to-one donor-specific H5/metadata barcode reconciliation after converting each matrix '-1' suffix to the released donor-specific metadata suffix '.1' through '.8'. Raw H5 matrices may contain additional unannotated barcodes; every released annotated barcode must match uniquely and only annotated nuclei enter biological summaries. This join clarification was frozen before outcomes after schema inspection.

donors.ovary5_exact_age: UNRESOLVED_47_SNRNA_49_GEO_AND_SNATAC; group retained as reproductively aged; numeric age never used

eligibility: Every one of four young and four reproductively-aged donors must have >=20 annotated nuclei in the broad cell type; otherwise all cell-type inferential endpoints are untestable

models.additional_covariates: none; all donors female and no usable donor-level procurement/PMI measurements are released

P1_transport.matched_null: primary model; conventional and matched-null p-values receive separate BH families

donor_pseudobulk_gene.multiplicity: BH across every tested cell-type-by-gene combination within model

donor_CLR_composition.depth: mean log raw UMI over all annotated donor nuclei

Hellinger_displacement.reference: Cross-fitted young-group raw-count reference within broad cell type after technical-gene exclusions; leave evaluated young donor out and use all eligible young donors for aged donors
Hellinger_displacement.cell_filter: >=1500 raw UMI and positive nontechnical UMI
Hellinger_displacement.technical_exclusions: MT-, RPL/RPS/MRPL/MRPS prefixes and XIST, TSIX, DDX3Y, EIF2S3Y, UTY, KDM5D
Hellinger_displacement.floors: 20 qualifying nuclei per scored donor, >=50 cross-fitted young-reference nuclei per donor, and all four donors per group after filtering
Hellinger_displacement.otherwise: untestable; never substitute zero or a null result

multiplicity: BH separately by endpoint and model; P1 conventional and matched-null families separate; pseudobulk BH is across all cell-type-by-gene tests in each model; sensitivity families are not pooled with primary families
